pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Aurora mesa tree (pinned to the Aurora kernel's DRM UAPI): Asahi Gallium and Zink OpenGL plus the Honeykrisp Vulkan driver, built so the native drivers link neither LLVM nor SPIRV-Tools. Shader precompilers come from dev-util/mesa_clc at the same pin. Replaces media-libs/mesa.

use.flag: Build the Honeykrisp Vulkan driver for Asahi GPUs
